task.title: Task form: stop the one-second refresh from breaking keyboard use of dependencies
task.description: Found while reviewing the single dependency field; all three already happen on main. (1) The task page's one-second refresh redraws the dependency list and the picker: a focused Remove button is destroyed and focus drops to the page, and the picker's highlighted option resets after arrow-key moves, so a keyboard user can barely use either. (2) After adding a dependency, focus goes to the page body instead of staying in the picker. (3) Depends On still offers tasks that this task already blocks; adding one would be a cycle and the server refuses it. Now that both kinds share one list, those tasks sit right above the picker.
